topic: Everyday engineering - Taipei 101 tuned mass damper (giant golden ball)
question: WHY IS THIS GIANT BALL
INSIDE THE BUILDING?
options: It stores power for the elevators
answer_full: To cancel out the swaying. It's a tuned mass damper
recap: During a typhoon in Taiwan, a giant golden ball hanging high up inside the Taipei 101 skyscraper started to swing.
explain: In strong winds, even a giant skyscraper sways a little. High up at the top, people can feel that movement.
The ball hangs like a huge pendulum. When the building moves one way, the six hundred and sixty ton ball lags behind and pulls the other way.
Hydraulic dampers underneath turn that motion into heat, so the swaying dies down much faster. Engineers call it a tuned mass damper.
